Republicans don’t just want abortion illegal—they want it unspeakable.

Recently, these supposed free speech enthusiasts got an abortion providers' speech canceled at Texas Tech claiming it would constitute “illegal activity.”

So we're giving her the platform conservatives took away.

This isn’t just about one speech or one school—we are in a make or break moment that will determine whether abortion becomes not just illegal, but unmentionable.

What we do now matters.

If you want to join us live and help power the kind of independent journalism and organizing that refuses to be silenced, I hope you’ll support Abortion, Every Day with a paying membership.

symptom suppression"

www.politico.com/news/2026/04...

When I say I've been warning about this for years, I mean it. Here's a piece I wrote in 2023 laying out how Republicans would use crisis pregnancy centers to informally ban birth control jessica.substack.com/p/the-gops-p...

They don't name crisis pregnancy centers specifically, but that's exactly what they've been laying the groundwork for. Here's the breakdown I published this weekend jessica.substack.com/p/the-week-i...

I'll have more in tomorrow's newsletter, but the short version is exactly what the Politico headline says: the administration wants to take federal dollars for contraception access for low-income women and give it to groups that focus on "natural family planning methods" and "infertility services"

I've warned for years that Republicans planned to reroute federal family planning dollars to crisis pregnancy centers—groups that won't even talk about birth control. 

I re-upped that prediction just last week. A day later, this Politico piece dropped. 
jessica.substack.com/p/the-white-...

Since the end of Roe, Republicans have been systematically burying maternal death reports and dismantling the committees that put them together. 
 
jessica.substack.com/p/is-florida...

Every local reporter should be calling their town’s CPC and asking where they stand on jailing and executing patients. These are groups that claim to support women! 

Ask how they feel about the nation's biggest network publicly aligning with a movement who wants women dead.

Instead of just noting what a shit show this is and moving on, consider holding your reps responsible: 

Every lawmaker voted to fund CPCs should be asked if they believe taxpayer dollars should go to groups that support executing abortion patients.

I know there's a lot happening right now, but please understand that this is a big deal: 

Heartbeat International has thousands of crisis pregnancy centers nationwide and gets hundreds of millions in taxpayer dollars. 

And this is happening in a moment when Republicans are doubling down on CPCs

The country's largest network of crisis pregnancy centers has publicly aligned itself with 'abolitionists'—the movement that wants abortion patients to get the death penalty jessica.substack.com/p/the-most-d...
Crisis pregnancy centers are DANGEROUS.
So which is it: are CPCs legitimate health centers that can replace Planned Parenthood, or are they non-medical centers that just dole out ultrasounds for funsies?

Just a reminder that these are the places Republicans argue should replace the Planned Parenthood clinics their policies are shuttering. 

This story also comes at the same time that multiple states are passing bills to ban the regulation of crisis pregnancy centers 🤡

A Texas woman nearly died after a crisis pregnancy center missed her ectopic pregnancy. 

The staff there said it's not their problem, though, because the ultrasound was “for educational purposes only.” www.dallasnews.com/business/hea...
they really thought they did something

National Review accuses me of lying about the rise in maternal mortality since the end of Roe: "It turns out that maternal mortality rates declined in 2024 according to the CDC."

You absolute fucking tools, that's *national data*—take a look at what's happening in states where abortion is banned
Anyway, consider subscribing to my newsletter if you don't already - I've been tracking this story for months and will have more tonight jessica.substack.com

This is exactly why we need every major outlet to hire dedicated repro reporters - and why I publish Abortion, Every Day. 

We are *fucked* if our gov't can label IUDs and the pill "abortion" and the nation's biggest papers don't think that's worth writing about

This wasn't some random mistake: both the State Department and USAID called the contraceptives 'abortion'. 

And when international groups tried to buy the stockpile so it wouldn’t be destroyed, the administration refused, citing the Global Gag Rule. A policy that prevents U.S. funding FOR ABORTION
